mainEntity.name: What is a Web Application Security Assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Web Application Security Assessment evaluates your web application for vulnerabilities, security misconfigurations, and compliance gaps to protect user data and business operations.

mainEntity.name: Why is web application security important?

acceptedAnswer.text: Web applications are prime targets for cyberattacks. Security assessments prevent data breaches, protect customer information, and reduce business risks.

mainEntity.name: How often should web applications be tested?

acceptedAnswer.text: Web applications should be tested regularly - at least once a year, or after major updates or feature releases - to ensure ongoing protection against vulnerabilities.

mainEntity.name: What types of vulnerabilities are tested?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our assessment covers authentication, authorization, session management, input validation, SQL injection, XSS, business logic flaws, and other common and advanced vulnerabilities.
Our assessments are conducted by experienced security professionals certified by industry standards and empanelled with CERT-IN, ensuring reliable and thorough testing.
You receive a detailed report including prioritized vulnerabilities, root cause analysis, recommended fixes, and actionable guidance to improve overall application security.

mainEntity.name: How long does the assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration depends on the application’s size and complexity, typically ranging from 1-3 weeks for medium-sized applications.

mainEntity.name: Is testing disruptive to live applications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our assessments are designed to minimize disruption. Testing is performed carefully to avoid downtime while simulating real-world attack scenarios.

mainEntity.name: How do you ensure compliance standards are met?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our methodology aligns with OWASP, SANS, and industry standards to ensure your web application meets compliance and regulatory requirements.

mainEntity.name: How can I get started with a security assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can get started by contacting ISECURION via our Contact Us page to schedule a free consultation and initiate the assessment process.
